sentences.text: Blueprint Technologies Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-08-07 under the industry code 62100, computer programming activities.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-07, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-12.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and nothing in the record shows a fit with the thesis.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and thesis fit is one of the things still unknown.
